canonicalizers.boolean: Use JSON true or false for Boolean types; do not quote a Boolean.
canonicalizers.entity: Copy entity text only from speech or bounded plan spans; preserve identity and do not substitute an example value.
canonicalizers.list: Use one JSON array for a list and preserve the spoken item order.
canonicalizers.nested-schedule: For nested schedules, preserve public nesting, key names, event order, and JSON types exactly.
canonicalizers.null: Use JSON null only when a listed legal skeleton permits the key and the source explicitly supplies no value; omission and null are distinct.
canonicalizers.period: Represent a period in the public type and constraint form; do not silently convert units or invent an endpoint.
canonicalizers.url: Copy a spoken URL as one string and preserve its scheme, host, path, query, and fragment without invention.
